title: Avro codec instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One Avro codec instance's settings: the schema source, the codec's logical-type mapping and the Confluent registry framing used at a Kafka boundary. A format is a codec used by other connectors, not a source, so this config names no endpoint and holds no secrets (§33 Appendix A.6; CN1 plan Task 5; D356 keeps Avro at Kafka and registry boundaries only). The manifest's `secrets` list is empty because no property here carries a secret.

schema_source.description: Where the writer's Avro schema comes from. decode reads it from the container's header or the Confluent wire format's schema id.

schema.description: The Avro schema as its JSON form, when schema_source is `explicit`.

subject_prefix.description: The Confluent subject prefix this instance registers and reads schemas under, so two instances of one connector do not collide on a subject. Only consulted when a registry is configured (CN1 Task 5).

registry.description: The Confluent schema registry, for the wire format (magic byte 0x00 + a 4-byte schema id). CN1 Task 5 ships a client stub until Q344, so the URL is configuration and the calls are stubbed.

compatibility.description: The compatibility level the subjects are held to (D356; the manifest declares evolution: none for the codec itself).

container.description: Whether the encoder writes an object container file or a single-object encoding (CN1 Task 5 covers both).

sync_marker_every.description: Objects between sync markers in an object container file.

deflate_level.description: The deflate level for the `deflate` codec.

logical_types.description: The Avro logical types mapped on decode and encode, per the Arrow project's rules (CN1 Task 5's avro_logical_types_map).
